detail.longDescription: Hey HN, I’m an AI researcher who craves staying up to date on all of the state of the art techniques in my field. Yet I’ve become very frustrated with my workflow for discovering new papers. Google scholar alerts are too noisy, twitter is too skewed, and relying on word of mouth alone is too fragile. I created Papertrails to solve this problem for myself. Papertrails builds a feed of new research papers, personalized to your interests, based on your own library of papers. It’s free to use, so try it out and let me know what you think! — Note: The app only serves papers from arXiv, hoping to add other journals soon
